audience.text: Python developers building applications that require generating Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, and QR Code barcodes without system-level dependencies.

capabilities.text: Supports Code 128 (with automatic or forced Code Set selection), Code 39 (base and Extended), EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, and UPC-E.
capabilities.title: Encode multiple linear symbologies

capabilities.text: Encodes QR Code Model 2 versions 1-40 with selectable error correction level and encoding mode.
capabilities.title: Generate QR Code with configurable options

capabilities.text: Produces SVG via `to_svg()` and PNG via `to_png()`, with optional `RenderOptions` for scale, DPI, module width, colors, and text.
capabilities.title: Render barcodes to SVG and PNG

capabilities.text: Allows rendering through a custom `Renderer` subclass passed to `Barcode.render()`.
capabilities.title: Support custom renderers

capabilities.text: Defines specific exception types including `BarcodeError`, `EncodingError`, `RenderingError`, `SymbologyNotFoundError`, and others.
capabilities.title: Provide structured error handling

limitations.text: The library only generates barcodes and does not read or decode existing barcode images.
PDF rendering is not implemented; `Barcode.to_pdf()` and `PdfRenderer.render()` raise `NotImplementedError`.
ECI normalization and validation are not implemented despite `EncodeOptions` exposing an `eci_assignment_number` field.
GS1 data parsing and validation are not implemented despite `EncodeOptions` exposing a `gs1_enabled` field.

problems_solved.text: Provides a pure-Python, dependency-light solution for generating multiple barcode symbologies with deterministic output.
Enables flexible rendering to SVG and PNG formats with configurable options like scale, DPI, module width, and text display.
Supports both dedicated helper functions and a generic `generate()` entry point for selecting symbologies by name.
Offers structured configuration via dedicated options types for each symbology, including error correction for QR Code and check-digit handling for EAN/UPC.

product_summary.text: Aspose.BarCode FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, open-source library for generating deterministic, standards-compliant linear and 2D barcodes.

uncertainties: The exact set of symbology names accepted by `generate()` beyond those demonstrated in examples is not explicitly listed.
Whether `Barcode.render()` with a custom `Renderer` subclass is fully extensible beyond the provided `SvgRenderer`, `PngRenderer`, and `PdfRenderer` is not confirmed.
The behavior of `ResolvedRenderOptions` and how it differs from `RenderOptions` is not described in examples.

workflows.name: Generate and render a Code 128 barcode
workflows.text: Import `code128`, create a barcode with `code128(payload)`, then call `to_svg()` or `to_png()` to produce output.

workflows.name: Generate a QR Code with custom encoding options
workflows.text: Import `qr` and `QrOptions`, configure error correction and encoding mode, then render to PNG or SVG.

workflows.name: Select symbology by name using the generic entry point
workflows.text: Call `generate(symbology_name, payload)` to create a barcode for any supported symbology without importing a dedicated helper.

workflows.name: Render with custom options
workflows.text: Pass `RenderOptions` to `to_svg()`, `to_png()`, or `render()` to control scale, DPI, module width, colors, and text display.
